##############################################################################################################################
#
#  Magnetopause crossings (MPCs) identified in the Cluster spacecraft data between 2001 and 2020.
#
#  Cluster measurements retrieved from the Cluster Science Archive https://csa.esac.esa.int/csa-web/
#  via the PySpedas package https://github.com/spedas/pyspedas.
#
#  The description of the identification process using a Random Forest Classifier
#  and the methods used to collect the additional data can be found in sections 2-4 of:
#    Grimmich, N., Plaschke, F., Escoubet, C. P., Grison, B., Archer, M. O., Nakamura, R., & Sibeck, D. G., Constantinescu, O. D. (2024).
#    The Cluster Spacecraft's View of the Motion of the High-Latitude Magnetopause.
#    Annales Geophysicae.
#
#  The columns contain:
#    column 1: MPC number
#    column 2: Identified crossing time in UT
#    column 3: Observing spacecraft (C1 or C3)
#    column 4: Mean value of the CIS-HIA quality flags for the plasma moment and energy flux density data around the MPC
#	       See https://www.cosmos.esa.int/web/csa/documentation for more information on the quality flags
#	       After 2014 no flags available column filled with default 2
#    column 5: Quality value of the geometry of the spacecraft constellation: tethraeder elongation (Robert et al., 1998)
#    column 6: Quality value of the geometry of the spacecraft constellation: tethraeder planarity (Robert et al., 1998)
#    column 7: MP normal direction estimated using the Multi Spacecraft Timing method (Schwartz, 1998)
#    column 8: Cross-correlation coefficients between the four spacecraft used in the normal estimate
#    column 9: MP velocity estimate in km/s
#    column 10: Angle in degree between the estimated MP normal and the normal predicted by the Shue et al. (1998) model
#    column 11: Angle in degree between the estimated MP normal and the magnetosheath magnetic field outside of the MP
#    column 12: Slope calculated in the Walén test (Paschmann & Sonnerup, 2008)
#    column 13: Correlation coefficients of teh Walén test
#    column 14: Dipol tilt angle, the orientation of the dipole axis with respect to the Earth-Sun line, in degree
#    column 15: IMF Bx component associated with the MPC from the OMNI dataset in nT
#    column 16: IMF By component associated with the MPC from the OMNI dataset in nT
#    column 17: IMF Bz component associated with the MPC from the OMNI dataset in nT
#    column 18: IMF magnitude associated with the MPC from the OMNI dataset in nT
#    column 19: IMF cone angle associated with the MPC from the OMNI dataset in degree
#    column 20: IMF clock angle associated with the MPC from the OMNI dataset in degree
#    column 21: SW velocity x-component associated with the MPC from the OMNI dataset in km/s
#    column 22: SW velocity y-component associated with the MPC from the OMNI dataset in km/s
#    column 23: SW velocity z-component associated with the MPC from the OMNI dataset in km/s
#    column 24: Total SW ion velocity associated with the MPC from the OMNI dataset in km/s
#    column 25: SW ion density associated with the MPC from the OMNI dataset in cm^-3
#    column 26: SW ion temperatur associated with the MPC from the OMNI dataset in K
#    column 27: SW dynamic pressure associated with the MPC from the OMNI dataset in nPa
#    column 28: SW plasma beta associated with the MPC from the OMNI dataset
#    column 29: SW magnetosonic Mach number associated with the MPC from the OMNI dataset
#    column 30: SW Alfvén Mach number associated with the MPC from the OMNI dataset
#
##############################################################################################################################
